newsitem.title: PERU: Peru tax revenues up 2.1 pct in Sept vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Peru tax revenues up 2.1 pct in Sept vs yr ago.

text.p: Peru's tax revenues rose in September to 1.524 billion soles, 2.1 percent higher in nominal terms than the same month last year, the National Superintendency of Tax Administration (SUNAT) said on Thursday.
The SUNAT added that accumulated revenues for the first nine months were 14.864 billion soles, up 7.2 percent in real terms taking into account inflation.
Tax collection last year rose 27.7 percent nominally to 17.063 billion soles, from 13.363 billion soles in 1994.
Peru's consumer inflation was 11.7 percent in the year to September.
